verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own official MCP server that lets users operate Adyen through natural language from their chosen LLM client, which is direct first-party support for natural-language commands. The evidence is a single short doc line plus a probe confirming the page exists, with no detail on which operations can be run this way. The agentic-commerce features concern shoppers' AI agents making purchases, not users operating the product, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: documented scope of operations available via natural language, examples or tool listings, limits on what can be done, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
